title: Require the missing-request error for that ID and confirm unrelated existing request state is unchanged.
reason: A missing ID is refused, but any error is accepted. The expected missing-request diagnostic is available from the store. The only assertion accepts any error for a missing request, so an unrelated failure can satisfy the test. The first transition succeeds and a second call refuses, but the final stored grant is never read. A path that mutates before returning an error would pass. The second denial uses a different reason and returns an error, but the original reason is not checked after refusal.
action: Require the missing-request error for that ID and confirm unrelated existing request state is unchanged. Require the missing-request diagnostic and retain a valid deny companion. Use a distinct second token/duration, require the not-pending error and compare final state with the original grant. Require not-pending and assert the original Denied reason remains intact.

title: Assert the expected real decision event and request ID before checking that shadow and divergence events are absent.
reason: The real decision is returned, but the audit assertions only require absence. A completely silent audit sink would pass. Two decision events are counted without checking their shadow flags or request identity. Two copies of the real event could pass. It proves the real grant remains unchanged and a deny divergence is emitted, but does not identify the blocking rule or correlate the divergence request. An always-deny rules shadow can pass.
action: Assert the expected real decision event and request ID before checking that shadow and divergence events are absent. Require exactly one real and one shadow decision for the same request, with matching grant outcomes, before asserting zero divergence. Add a nonblocked same-action resource companion and assert the request ID plus rule-specific rationale/check evidence for the blocked case.
